title: Resolve the narrow-window horizontal layout contract for the measured session list
outcome: Resolve the pre-existing <=900px horizontal session-strip rule when the measured row adapter wraps the list, preserving bounded DOM and deliberate responsive navigation behavior.
acceptance: Choose and document the narrow-window session-list layout, with responsive browser coverage of the supported orientation.
The chosen layout keeps DOM bounded and retains logical keyboard entry, session actions, and reachable final sessions.
